newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures end weak in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures end weak in thin trade.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Italian debt markets down in wake of strong showing in French elections for opposition Socialists but traders note market thin as London and U.S. closed and real market reaction will be clearer on Tuesday. Meanwhile, rate cut hopes in Italy persist and market also looks to ruling coalition leaders' meeting with Prime Minister Prodi later this evening for titbits about on government's three-year economic plan.
* Bonds:Feb07 -70 bps at 96.57, yield 7.28 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 135 bps.
* Lira:986.30/6.50 per mark vs 989 area early.
